comparator.raw_input: same unchanged OCR output for all three

policy_metrics.full_frame: all scheduled documents and all declared field/cell/absence opportunities
policy_metrics.candidate_count: all actual emitted assignments including duplicates and blanks
policy_metrics.strict_known_exact: exactly one eligible candidate equals known printed value under unchanged NFC/outer trim
policy_metrics.required_abstention_violation: eligible required-abstention slot has one or more actual candidates
policy_metrics.required_abstention_observed: zero eligible candidates, separately counted by truth status; never exact-value accuracy
policy_metrics.unavailable: failed/not-run, absent native structure, parse error or unavailable visible grammar; no abstention credit
policy_metrics.rows: original exactness on declared known cells; known row key required; partial truth explicit
policy_metrics.surplus: outside full policy universe separately from original extra_cells
policy_metrics.summary: pooled counts, case/family groups, equal-family means with contributing denominators

runtime_preparation.reuse: read-only pinned Q0 environment/model/notices and accepted coverage_v1 finite supervision semantics
runtime_preparation.limits: source release must bind exact model/dependency observations, module identities, storage/free-space/time limits and lease
runtime_preparation.network_limit: library offline settings are not proof of OS outbound denial
runtime_preparation.dependency_limit: preserve approved torchvision local-SHA TOFU disclosure
